write_boundary: Write boundary: no target writes before final confirmation.
automation_boundary: Automation: no commit / no push / no PR / no merge.
dry_run_complete: Dry Run complete: target repository remains unchanged.
installation_blocked: Installation blocked: readiness facts require resolution before confirmation.
installation_cancelled: Installation cancelled; target repository remains unchanged.
installation_preview_failed: Installation preview failed; no target changes were made.
next_action_review: Next action: review the generated Work Item and branch; the installer did not commit, push, create a PR, merge, or delete the branch.
next_action_calibration: Calibration remains separate; installation does not activate the selected governance profile or prove production readiness.
rollback_boundary_failed: The Installer reported failure and owns rollback; inspect the target state before retrying.
unknown_na_boundary: Unknown remains explicit; N/A requires a reason.
paused_resume: Paused; resume with the same session file.
